original.statement: Loki 3.0.0 adds a new cache statistic `query_length_served` to the Results Cache to measure the length of query results served from cache.

decision.reason: [ev-daa5d5e91665] describes `query_length_served` as a new cache stat that measures the length of the query served from the results cache. It is a statistic Loki outputs, not a key operators set in a configuration file, so the config-key subject misreads the text. None of the available subject families covers an output statistic, so no corrected assertion follows from the evidence.
